_about: Column classification, units and measure rules. Rules are applied in order; the first matching rule sets the classification. Columns not matched by a sensitive rule are 'public' (the Silver audit scanned every string column for e-mail/phone and lists all findings in §9).

public.description: May be selected, filtered and joined by any role authorized for the object.
public.source: Silver audit §9 (no findings); Gold build rule 5 (no personal or free-text fields in Gold)

lineage.description: Technical lineage (hashes, Bronze file names, run ids). Output only for data_steward.
lineage.source: Silver audit §8 (lineage columns are not features)

restricted.description: Internal identifiers and references: data_steward may filter or join on them, nobody may output them.
restricted.source: D-14b (supplier_id: internal joins only); Gold comments exclude references

prohibited.description: Personal, free-text or masked content: never selected, filtered or joined.
prohibited.source: D-14 (notice text), D-14b and Silver audit §9 (supplier names, descriptions), Gold build rule 5 (raw records)

rules.source: Silver audit §9 (free text; redaction required before display)
D-14b (supplier_id pseudonymised in outputs; internal joins only)
Gold table comments (references excluded from Gold)

units.unit: World Bank fiscal year (1 July to 30 June)

measure_families.source: SILVER_RELATIONSHIP_REPORT.md, Measures that must stay separate

non_additive_source: Percentiles, rates, scores, indicator values, dates and years are not summable (kpi_queries.py; view comments)
